query:
SELECT 
  rel.id, 
  rel.reference_id, 
  rel.entity_type, 
  rel.entity_id, 
  rel.link_type,
  rel.relevance_score,
  v3.title as ref_title
FROM reference_entity_links rel
LEFT JOIN v3_references v3 ON rel.reference_id = v3.id
LIMIT 20;
